p: it: That is, the city.
LORD liveth: Though they pretend religion and holiness, yet all is but hypocrisy: for under this kind of swearing is contained the true religion.
truth: Do you not love uprightness and faithful dealing?
stricken them: You have often punished them, but all is in vain, Isa 9:13.
great men: He speaks this to the reproach of them who would govern and teach others, and yet are farther out of the way than the simple people.
lion from the forest shall slay: Meaning, Nebuchadnezzar and his army.
sworn by them that are no: He shows that to swear by anything other than by God is to forsake him.
Go ye up upon her walls: He commands the Babylonians and enemies to destroy them.
take away her battlements: Read Jer 4:27.
lied about the LORD: Because they gave no credit to the words of his prophets, as in Isa 28:15.
wind: Their words will be of no effect, but vain.
not in them: They are not sent from the Lord, and therefore that which they threaten to us will come on them.
thy mouth fire: Meaning, Jeremiah.
from far: That is, the Babylonians and Chaldeans.
open sepulchre: Who will kill many with their arrows.
you: Here the Lord declares his unspeakable favour toward his Church, as in Jer 4:27.
thou answer them: Meaning, the prophet Jeremiah.
iniquities have turned away these things: If there is any stay, that we receive not God's blessings in abundance, we must consider that it is for our own iniquities, Isa 59:1,2.
prosper: They feel not the plague of God for it.
prophets prophesy falsely: Meaning that there could be nothing but disorder, where the ministers were wicked and corrupt.
